item.title: SIA arrests AC technician for supplying AK-47 to doctor in expanding terror case
item.description: SIA has arrested an AC technician from Srinagar for allegedly supplying the AK-47 recovered from the locker of a doctor already in NIA custody. Investigations have uncovered connections between the technician, suicide bomber Dr. Umar Nabi, and a wider terror module spanning Kashmir and Faridabad.

item.title: Jennifer Lopez
item.description: Netizens criticised Manish Malhotra for the ill-fitted bralette he designed for Jennifer Lopez, saying it made her appear vulgar. A few still appreciated the rose-gold colour, especially in the sun-kissed shots. Her performance outfits were further criticised; most were skimpy, including a nude-coloured, body-hugging leather bandage suit seen in a now-viral reel.

item.title: Police detain 15 people during Delhi pollution protest; officials say youth
item.description: The protests have been taking place as visibility dropped across several parts of the city as the toxic haze thickened, prompting renewed health warnings from authorities. Neighbouring NCR cities are also struggling with deteriorating air quality. Faridabad reported an AQI of 358, Gurugram 370, Ghaziabad 355, Greater Noida 342, and Noida 372.

item.description: "With the index still trading above its 20, 50, and 200 EMAs, the broader trend stays positive. Key resistance levels are placed at 26,100 and 26,250, while support stands at 26,000 and 25,900, supporting a buy-on-dips approach with disciplined stop-losses," they added.

item.title: Gold prices slide 1 pc on MCX as Fed Rate cut hopes fade
item.description: The latest US job market data reduced expectations of a 25-basis-point rate cut by the Federal Reserve in December, which has been a key reason behind the correction in prices. The strong economic data pushed the US dollar index to nearly a six-month high on Friday.

item.title: Rupee up 26 paise at open as RBI support boosts sentiment
item.description: On November 21, the rupee had slipped to a record low of 89.49 against the dollar. The fall was driven by foreign investor outflows from Indian equities, uncertainty around a possible US-India trade deal, and a lack of visible intervention from the RBI at that time.
